summary_for_children: As-Saffat means Those Lined Up in Ranks. It tells of Nuh, Ibrahim's trial with his son, Musa and Harun, Ilyas, Lut and Yunus, and how Allah saved them.
environment_concept: A sky adorned with stars (37:6), an open shore (37:145) and a gourd vine over a shady spot (37:146).
architecture_and_scenery: Starry dome, an ark on hills, a quiet hilltop recalling Ibrahim's trial through landscape only, a shore with a gourd vine.

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Ibrahim's Great Test
story_library.children_narration: Surah As-Saffat recalls several prophets, including Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Harun, Ilyas, Lut, and Yunus. Ibrahim experienced an extraordinary test involving his son, and Allah provided a great sacrifice in his place. The surah teaches trust and obedience while reminding us of Allah's mercy.

world_idea.title: The Paths of Trust
world_idea.description: Several distinct story areas include an ancient sanctuary-inspired setting, an environmental retelling of Ibrahim's test without human depiction, and a maritime setting for Yunus's account.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: Ibrahim's test with his son (37:102-107) is reading only. No knife, altar or ram scene is shown. The library's "environmental retelling" is dropped.
